name: sol-pi-advisor
description: The primary task plans and accepts, one or more safe local Pi lanes implement, and a fresh Sol reviewer gives the final verdict.

interface.shortDescription: A primary task directs Pi implementation and fresh Sol review.
interface.longDescription: A first-principles supervised delivery workflow: the primary creates an issues.md execution ledger, dispatches only READY items, excludes user-suspended non-blocking items, binds every fine-grained issue ID to one Pi run/session, permits two matching corrections, gives exhausted micro-fixes at most two primary rounds, and obtains fresh read-only Sol review.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Pi Advisor to implement this task through local Pi and fresh Sol review.

Derive the goal from first principles into a repository-root issues.md ledger, assign stable IDs, schedule only READY fine-grained items through one bound Pi run/session with at most two matching corrections, exclude user-suspended non-blocking items until explicitly resumed, verify the results, then obtain fresh Sol review.
